A salon built around one promise

Rose & Pearl opened in 2018 with a simple idea: a ladies-only space where nothing feels rushed — not the consultation, not the colour, not the coffee.

Every appointment starts with a proper chat about your hair and skin, and ends with honest aftercare advice. If a treatment is not right for you, we will say so.
